title: From MMS Command Misuse to Process Disruption — Software Artifact (Baseline IDS, Scripts, Configs)
description: Software artifact accompanying the ESORICS paper 'From MMS Command Misuse to Process Disruption: Threat Modeling and Experimental Analysis in IEC 61850 Digital Substations'. Contains the baseline hybrid IDS implementation (deterministic + ML fusion), feature generation and sequence-window construction, evaluation and reporting scripts, baseline configuration files, and reproduction documentation. The companion dataset record (normalized MMS corpus, ground-truth labels, sample data) is available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20696377.
